data.narrative:
Ark Robotics is a seed-stage defense and security robotics company founded by Achi Takagama. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private companies and 2 public companies operating in the Defense & Security sector, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method was the applicable triangulation approach given data availability. The analysis identified three same-sector, same or adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B valuation (seed stage), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). The median valuation across these three peers is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This peer-median method implies a $400M valuation for Ark Robotics.

The triangulated valuation analysis supports a range of $340M to $460M, with a median of $400M. The relatively wide range reflects heterogeneity in the peer set, particularly the $875M spread between the highest and lowest comparables. Key uncertainties include the limited sample size of one applicable valuation method, early-stage revenue visibility, and the nascent maturity of frontier robotics in defense applications. Validation against revenue multiples or disclosed funding rounds would strengthen conviction in this range.
